name: Banyan Tree Cabo Marques
positioning: Clifftop resort of private pool villas above the Pacific in Acapulco's Diamond Zone, blending Thai-inspired design with Mexican craftsmanship
best_for: Couples looking for a private pool villa with ocean or bay views
Spa lovers interested in Thai and Balinese massages with Mexican ingredients

facts.text: The resort is set on the cliff tops above the Pacific Ocean in Acapulco's Diamond Zone.
Located in Punta Diamante, the resort is set within a gated cliffside enclave.
The villas blend Thai-inspired design with Mexican craftsmanship.
All villas include a private pool, with heating available upon request.
Guests can choose from villa locations and views including Hillside, Bay View, Ocean View and Oceanfront, subject to availability.
The Ocean View Two-Bedroom Family Pool Villa has two separate pavilions, one with a king-size bed and one with twin beds, a shared sundeck and a heated private pool overlooking the Pacific.
Spa guests are led to a private therapy pavilion, where they sip herbal tea during a foot bath.
Besides the private villa pools, the resort has the Reflections Infinity Pool near Cello restaurant.
The Las Rocas Infinity Pool sits in an intimate corner of the resort along the coastline.
Saffron is the resort's Thai restaurant.
Resort activities include tequila and mezcal tastings and cooking classes.

highlights.text: The Oceanfront Pool Villa has a king-size bed oriented toward the horizon, expansive verandas and a private heated infinity pool that seems suspended above the water.
The spa combines Asian healing traditions with Mexico's apapacho.
Signature spa treatments are Thai and Balinese massages enhanced with Mexican ingredients like honey, cacao and lavender.
The Wellbeing Sanctuary Pool Villa has spaces for yoga, meditation and private practice, with wellbeing equipment such as yoga mats.
An in-villa barbecue service turns the villa's timber terrace into a private open-air restaurant with a personal chef.

considerations.text: Because of its clifftop location, the resort has no on-site beach; beach clubs are about 20 minutes away.
The resort is about 15 km, roughly a 25-minute drive, from Acapulco city centre.
The resort is primarily designed for couples and does not offer dedicated children's facilities, though families are welcome.
